paper_title: Search for axion-like dark matter with ferromagnets
notes: SHAFT (Search for Halo Axions with Ferromagnetic Toroids) reports exclusion limits on axion-like particle electromagnetic coupling g_agamma over the mass range 12 peV to 12 neV (frequency range 3 kHz to 3 MHz). The best limit quoted in the abstract is 4.0×10^-11 GeV^-1 at 20 peV. Data points extracted from the exclusion plot (Fig. 4c) by reading approximate coupling values across the mass range, assuming a roughly power-law trend consistent with the narrowing linewidth β²νa ≈ 10^-6 νa in the standard halo model. The experiment uses ferromagnetic toroidal cores to enhance the static magnetic field by a factor of 24, achieving SQUID magnetic sensitivity of 150 aT/√Hz. No axion signal was detected; limits are set at 95% CL using the antisymmetric channel. Local dark matter density ρ_DM = 0.45 GeV/cm³ = 3.6×10^-42 GeV⁴ is assumed per the standard halo model. | selector: text (sole candidate)
